generic_probes.text: Is the target being treated as a concept/sense rather than a concrete individual referent?
Does the target have an actual current-world referent under the supplied benchmark context?
Is the target explicitly fictional under the supplied context?
Is the target definition explicitly based on negation or complement?
Would changing the universe/domain change the target's extension?
Is enough context supplied to determine the intended interpretation?
Does interpretation require knowing a speaker/location?
Does interpretation require a reference time?
Does interpretation require a comparison class or threshold?
Does the supplied context make category membership/application crisp rather than borderline?
Is self-reference essential to the target?
Does the supplied benchmark representation contain or require an inconsistency?
Can the relevant truth/application status be determined from the information available to this oracle?
Is the unresolved status due to a stochastic future outcome rather than missing factual access?
Is a general undecidability result part of why the target cannot be settled by an algorithm in all cases?
Is the target conventionally lexicalized or given a conventional expression in the benchmark language?
Can the target be paraphrased from the information currently supplied?
Does the designated oracle have direct access to the information needed for the judgment?
